individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the n=141 points is itself an individual sample measurement, not an aggregate.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown; points and marginal histograms represent raw individual measurements.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each point is a per-cell-line mean of 6 replicate samples plus error bars; the underlying individual replicate values are not shown.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are defined in the caption as mean plus or minus standard deviation.

individual-data-points.explanation: Density/line plots of distributions are exempt from the individual-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on these density curves.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots are exempt, and individual sample dots are additionally overlaid on the boxes.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box, whisker, median and outlier elements are all explicitly defined in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histograms display the full probability distribution of phase differences, which is exempt from the individual-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown on these normalized polar histograms.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; distribution plots of this kind are exempt from showing individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on this polar histogram.

individual-data-points.explanation: Single illustrative line/fit example, not an averaged summary plot requiring individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present in this example fitting illustration.

individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the n=117 points is an individual sample's fitted parameters, with error bars reflecting per-sample fit uncertainty.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: The caption explicitly defines the error bars as the standard deviation of the fitted parameters.
